content: BUD-15 PR #104 defines chk-v1 CHK encryption: SHA256 plaintext as chk_key, HKDF-SHA256 to AES-256-GCM, fixed zero nonce, ciphertext hash as Blossom hash, enc=chk-v1 and k=<chk_key> URI parameters; review clarifies per-chunk key derivation and mandatory plaintext/ciphertext hash validation.
